reviewItem.question: Does "Added retry policy for inbound requests that automatically resets the requests that the service has not seen/processed" mean a change to env-var:istio|name=ENABLE_INBOUND_RETRY_POLICY (added)?

proposed.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds a retry policy for inbound requests that automatically resets requests the service has not seen/processed; setting ENABLE_INBOUND_RETRY_POLICY to false reverts it.
